title: Daily AI & Tech News Brief
summary: Concise AI, mobile, XR, and consumer technology news summaries with source links.

items.title: Defense-tech AI funding accelerates in 2026
items.summary: PitchBook data cited by the Financial Times says defense-technology companies building drones, battlefield AI, and related systems have raised $12.3 billion across 175 deals so far in 2026, already above the full-year 2025 total. The trend shows how military and dual-use AI have become a major venture-capital focus.

items.title: OpenAI says Samsung is rolling out ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to employees
items.summary: OpenAI announced that Samsung Electronics is deploying ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to employees worldwide. The rollout is positioned as one of OpenAI's largest enterprise AI deployments and shows Codex moving deeper into corporate software-development workflows.

items.title: Qwen posts a new Qwen Image Bench model repository
items.summary: Qwen's Hugging Face organization now lists Qwen-Image-Bench, a model/resource repository related to image benchmarking. It is an official model-listing signal rather than a full product announcement, but it is relevant for tracking Qwen's multimodal ecosystem.

items.title: DeepSeek lists DeepSeek V4 Flash on Hugging Face
items.summary: DeepSeek's official Hugging Face organization now lists DeepSeek-V4-Flash. The listing is a model-repository signal rather than a detailed launch post, but it is useful for monitoring DeepSeek's public model activity.

items.title: Hugging Face highlights MosaicLeaks research-agent secrecy benchmark
items.summary: Hugging Face published MosaicLeaks, a benchmark asking whether research agents can keep secrets. The work is relevant to agent security because it tests how AI systems handle confidential information while performing research-style tasks.

items.title: AryStinger malware turns legacy routers into a proxy network
items.summary: The Hacker News reports that AryStinger malware has infected thousands of legacy routers and is using them as a distributed reconnaissance and proxy network. The campaign highlights the ongoing risk from outdated home and small-office networking hardware.

items.title: BleepingComputer also tracks AryStinger's D-Link router infections
items.summary: BleepingComputer reports that the AryStinger botnet has compromised more than 4,000 outdated D-Link routers and uses them as proxies for malicious traffic. This provides a second cybersecurity source on the same router-malware trend without letting one outlet dominate the feed.

items.title: Subnautica 2 VR mod adds motion-controller support
items.summary: Road to VR reports that a Subnautica 2 VR mod now includes motion-controller support, letting players interact more directly with the game in VR. It is a consumer XR update rather than a platform launch, but it is relevant to VR software and modding activity.
